current_evidence: The council's 'Local validation list 2025 to 2027' page links this Guidance Document and the matching Matrix, and says 'the approved list of local validation requirements comes into effect from 1 January 2025' (after consultation from 16 Oct to 27 Nov 2024).

issues.detail: The List date 2024-12-01 comes from PDF metadata. The council page says the list came into effect on 1 January 2025, after consultation from 16 October to 27 November 2024, so 2025-01-01 is the correct date.
issues.evidence: Validation page: 'comes into effect from 1 January 2025'

issues.detail: Several local requirements in the 2025-2027 list are not captured: Air Source Heat Pump specifications and unit location (any proposal installing an ASHP); Assessment of Impact on the Norfolk Coast National Landscape (non-householder development in the NL outside settlement boundaries, or affecting its special qualities); Coastal Erosion Vulnerability Assessment (sites within SMP 0-25/25-50/50-100 year erosion zones); Health and Wellbeing Statement (250+ dwellings); Noise Impact Statement (noise-sensitive or noise-generating development); Odour Impact Assessment (significant odour sources or sensitive receptors near odorous processes); Minimum Space Standards (all new dwellings, emerging Policy HOU 9); Structural Survey (demolition of principal elements of listed buildings, locally listed or positive buildings in conservation areas, and all countryside barn/building conversions); Tier 1 Risk Screening Assessment (new or extended cemeteries); Topographical Survey/Cross Section (sloping sites steeper than 1 in 14); Use of Artificial Intelligence disclosure (any application where AI produced reports or supporting information); Utilities Assessment (over 100 dwellings or 10,000 sqm); Fire Statement; and Location Plan and Floor Plan requirements.
issues.evidence: Matrix 'Local Validation Requirements' rows; Guidance Document 'Required for' entries

issues.detail: Heritage Statement and Lighting Assessment are placed under Householder, but the source excludes householder development from both. The Lighting row's own trigger text says '(excluding Householder development)'.
issues.evidence: Guidance: Heritage Statement required for 'non-householder development' affecting heritage assets; Lighting: 'all development (excluding Householder development) where external lighting ... is proposed'

issues.detail: About 30 requirements are placed under 'Full planning' as 'INFERRED' (for example Travel Plan, Affordable Housing, Air Quality and Telecoms). The source matrix has explicit columns: Householder, Full, Outline, Reserved Matters, LBC, Advertisement, PiP, Technical Details, NMA, Variation of Condition, Change of Use, and Discharge. As a result, Reserved matters, Listed building consent, PiP, Variation and Discharge are all wrongly shown as '(none)'. For example, a Structural Survey applies to LBC, and plans apply to most types.
issues.evidence: Matrix column headings A-L; app_type_rows Listed building consent = '(none)'

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are cut off before the actual criteria, are column-scrambled, or only point elsewhere. Affordable Housing: 'Required for: a.'. Economic Statement: 'Required for: a. b. c. d.'. Contaminated Land: 'upon the A Contaminated Land Survey (Phase One) is required for: nature of the proposal: a.'. Foul Sewage: 'Foul Drainage Assessment When Required Guidance'. Flood Risk: 'for climate FRA should include... change (excluding minor extensions'. Outline/Landscaping: 'to Existing landscape details: 0.9 hectares excluding outline applications'. HRA: a page footer.

The 'Change of use - prior approval | Nutrient Neutrality' row loses most of the trigger. The source requires the statement for net new overnight accommodation in the River Wensum or River Bure catchments, including permitted development, across all application types, not only prior approvals.
issues.evidence: Guidance: Nutrient Neutrality Statement - net new overnight accommodation within the Wensum/Bure catchments

issues.detail: Some tab items are fragments or links rather than requirements. 'A Framework Definition (pdf) UKGBC-Net-Zero-Operational-Carbon-One-Pager.pdf 8.' is a guidance link. The protected-sites lines ('Special Areas of Conservation (SACs)... Page 19 of 28', 'To help you decide if a development proposal might affect... you can:') are definitions or fragments.

summary: Grokbot's link is to the current 2025-2027 list (in effect from 1 January 2025). The date should be 2025-01-01, not the metadata date. About 14 local requirements are missing, including the coastal erosion, National Landscape, ASHP, AI disclosure, structural survey and topographical survey items. Heritage and Lighting are wrongly applied to Householder, and most other items are guessed under Full planning instead of taken from the matrix columns.
